206  THE SAVOY MALE AND FEMALE COLLEGE

THE REUNION BANQUET AND LEVEE—The next assembly, the banquet of 8 p.m., was another "jubilee meeting" of the ex-students. The arrival of many who had not attended the morning and afternoon sessions crowded the facilities. Two

INFORMAL ACTIVITIES
Saturday, August 6, 1938

9:00 A.M.—Preliminary meeting of all committees in Halsell Memorial Auditorium.
Informal introductions, everybody meet everybody else.
